meta.name: host-observer
meta.description: Use this when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: reply only skip_summary or one full observation XML, never prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行Grok Bot的记忆观察任务,只输出标准总结或完整观测结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让机器人按规范格式输出记忆观察结果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a bot to report memory observations in a structured format.

howto.what: 在 claude-mem 观察者任务中，它只回两种结果：`<skip_summary reason="noise" />`，或一条完整 `<observation>` XML（含标题、4–10 条事实与叙述），不写散文。
howto.when: 当它在 Grok Bot 上执行 claude-mem observer 作业时接管：空闲、初始化或没有工具结果时回 skip_summary，完成可检索单元时回一条 observation。

say.text: 把刚完成的搜索单元写成一条 observation XML
say.note: 它返回带标题和 4–10 条事实的 XML

say.text: 这次没有工具结果，直接回 skip_summary
别回散文，只回 observation 或 skip_summary

howto.what_en: Once installed, it answers claude-mem observer jobs with only two outputs: `<skip_summary reason="noise" />` or one complete `<observation>` XML with a real title, 4–10 facts and a narrative — never prose.
howto.when_en: It takes over when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: skip_summary for idle, init or no tool results; one observation when a searchable unit is finished.

say_en.text: Turn the finished search unit into one observation XML
say_en.note: Returns XML with a title and 4–10 facts

say_en.text: No tool results this time — just reply skip_summary
Don't write prose, reply only observation or skip_summary
